title.en: Support for a retiring staff member

summary.en: A monthly contribution scheme was organised for a D-staff member facing a run of family difficulties.
summary.kn: ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ಸರಣಿ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಡಿ-ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾಸಿಕ ಕೊಡುಗೆ ಯೋಜನೆ ಆಯೋಜಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.

archiveNote: This record was first published by the alumni community in an earlier era. Obsolete bank and payment details have been removed for privacy and safety; the historical account is otherwise intact.
